data.description: In order to facilitate debugging we need a dev mode cheat that will replace a card in the market with a chosen card. This will be a button in the debug section of the settings menu. When the button is pressed a window opens that displays all the cards in the game, grouped by type. There is a set of filters including (at least) by type and a text box which filters by partial title. When a card in the list is selected (arrow keys + enter or mouse) it will replace a random card in the current market available cards.
data.title: Add a dev mode cheat to add a specific card to the market
